local_rules.deck_heal_cost: Freeze selected original deck local cost before ordinary materialization, then heal the hero after delivery. Hand intrinsic/player discounts are not retroactive. Exact CN replacement windows deferred.
local_rules.treant_board_price: Complete fixed29 IDs, current face, ordinary friendly board rows, two mana each. Preserve both full ordered boards and the existing board-count policy including Dormant minions. Tribe-all and names do not qualify. Exact CN scope edges deferred.
local_rules.brochure_flip: Reuse harmonic policy: actual holder turn_ended while in hand only. Native Arcane alternate retained. Precise CN flip window deferred.
local_rules.brochure_draws: The two actual original SPELL-query roots receive their own local discount only while the same hand residence remains valid. Draw-cast replacement children and reaction extras are excluded. Existing explicit same-entity draw transformations keep their original residence policy.
local_rules.dew_start: One permanent independent program per effect; both actual turn_started players receive an ordinary draw before normal start draw through existing pipeline. Relative CN trigger order deferred.
local_rules.spellstone_upgrade: Actual armor event amount and clear_local. Excess stays within current stage; no carry into next stage on the same event.
local_rules.convoke_source: Use unchanged CORE_REV_365 behavior and complete constructed.cards Druid spell query. Unknown reachable effects stay explicit failures; no candidate trimming.
